content:
Laredo's El Metro Transit System has added two new bus stops and is preparing upgrades at several existing stops around the city, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The new stops are at 5240 San Bernardo Ave., inbound, which took effect Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026, serving Routes 1, 2A, 2B and C-3; and at McPherson Road and Marshall Street, outbound, effective Thursday, Oct. 22, 2026, for Route 3, the paper reported.

Photos shared Oct. 21 showed maintenance workers taking measurements around existing stops, including stops along Ejido Avenue and Clark Boulevard. Details of the specific upgrades at those stops were to be released later, according to the report.

El Metro operates more than 47 fixed-route buses, one trolley and 15 demand-response El Lift vans. Updates are available through El Metro Transit System or elmetrotransit.com, the paper reported.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, “El Metro announces new bus stops as transit upgrades get underway,” by Maria Ruiz, Oct. 23, 2026.

title: El Metro adds two new Laredo bus stops as transit upgrades get underway
